### [BUG-XXX] Bug Summary
**Assignee:** @AssigneeHandle
**Role:** [Developer / DB Admin / Test Engineer / UI/UX / Scrum Master]
**Description:**
Describe the defect discovered, including steps to reproduce and observed vs expected behavior.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Steps to reproduce identified and documented.
- [ ] Root cause resolved in code or database configuration.
- [ ] Passing automated integration/regression tests added.
- [ ] Verified by QA on the target branch.
